questions.stem: What is a zero-level channel of distribution?
questions.explanation: A zero-level channel involves direct sales from the producer to the consumer without any intermediaries, making it the most straightforward distribution method.

distractorRationale.b: This describes a one-level channel, which includes one intermediary.
distractorRationale.c: This describes a two-level channel, which has two intermediaries.
distractorRationale.d: This option incorrectly limits the definition to wholesalers only.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a function of middlemen?
questions.explanation: Middlemen do not manufacture products; their primary role is to facilitate distribution and reduce costs associated with transactions.

distractorRationale.a: Reducing transaction costs is indeed a function of middlemen.
distractorRationale.b: Providing storage is a key function of middlemen in the distribution process.
distractorRationale.d: Distributing products is a fundamental role of middlemen.

questions.stem: Which channel would be most suitable for a luxury product?
questions.explanation: A two-level channel is often more suitable for luxury products as it involves specialized retailers who can provide a premium shopping experience.

distractorRationale.a: Zero-level channels may not provide the necessary marketing support for luxury products.
distractorRationale.b: One-level channels may not have the expertise needed for luxury goods.
distractorRationale.d: This option is incorrect as two-level channels are indeed suitable.
